parts.text: Inspect ChatMachines/TokenizerCalibration/agents-by-header-flattened.json. Check the complete flattened projection and determine whether ANY key in ANY projection element is a parent with more than one immediate child. Evaluate this structurally, not semantically. A keyed object parent fails this check if its object value contains more than one immediate property. For arrays, inspect each contained object in the same way; an array having multiple source members represented as separate projection elements is not itself a violation. Report: (1) YES or NO, (2) total number of violations, and (3) for every violation, the projection element and exact nested path to the parent key plus its immediate children. The purpose is to verify that the flattened projection is atomic and that no object parent retains multiple children in a single projection element. Do not modify any file.
